About us

Meet John

John has been working in the roofing trade across Staffordshire and the surrounding areas for 30 years, keeping people's homes safe, dry and protected. From a small repair to a complete new roof, no job is too big or too small.

What that means for you is the bit most people find hardest to get. Someone turns up when they said they would, tells you what the roof actually needs rather than what is easiest to sell, uses materials that will still be doing their job in twenty years, and puts the price in writing.

  • We look at the actual roof before quoting, never from the pavement
  • You get photographs of the parts you cannot climb up to see
  • If a repair will do, we will say so rather than sell you a new roof
